name: Asakura Yoshikage
source: The head of the Asai Asakura house. Even though he never killed a man in battle, he seized power by driving men into suicide. Politics are his forte and he wishes to win battles without war. Since he manipulates political marriages, he has many children (at least 20), and has currently sent out his first 8 sons as spies.
